Game Overview

In Cursed Treasure 2, the core idea is straightforward: defend your dark realm as an Overlord in Cursed Treasure 2. Employ cunning strategies, command a legion of orcs, undead, and demons, and unleash powerful spells to thwart hero invaders and protect your precious magical gems in this captivating tower defense challenge. Victory hinges on your tactical prowess!
